candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Intern, Research Working Student – Environmental Psychology Datasets
letter.opening: I am applying for the Research Working Student position on environmental psychology datasets. Finding, curating, standardising and annotating datasets so that models can learn from them is careful work I enjoy, and I would like to contribute it to research on how people experience designed spaces.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. I have built datasets and evaluation sets in my projects and validated and documented data in industry.

achievements.impact: for DocuMind I built a 22-question test set with expected answers and evidence pages, plus 4 deliberately unanswerable questions, and recorded document sources and licenses
for my B.S. thesis team I created training data and evaluated and tuned the event detection model
in industry I used SQL validation and reconciliation and documented sources and calculations for every dataset behind a dashboard

letter.problems_section: I would search for open datasets and published experiments, standardise trial-level data into a common format, annotate metadata and document the work. Environmental psychology and cognitive architectures such as Soar are new to me, and I am motivated to learn them in a research team.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to the Bonn area and can work up to 20 hours per week, starting immediately. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
